method.cold_definition: Every extraction is a fresh yt-dlp process with a private HOME/XDG_*/TMPDIR, no cookie file, no user profile and no shared runtime cache.
method.cpu_method: getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) delta around each extraction; on Linux this is transitive, so the frozen yt-dlp's embedded CPython and the JS runtime child are both included.
method.description: Cold yt-dlp extractions per JS runtime on a challenged YouTube video plus two controls, serialized (one extraction at a time).
method.rss_method: Maximum sampled sum of process-tree RSS over the whole yt-dlp process tree; shared pages may be counted once per mapping process and short-lived spikes may be missed.

scenarios.description: challenged video with the web_embedded player client; the JS runtime is load-bearing here (a broken or missing runtime makes the extraction fail)
challenged video with the default player client, i.e. the exact production flag set; the runtime is still invoked by yt-dlp but the extraction can also succeed without it
unchallenged video, default player client; the runtime is only probed for its version unless YouTube decides to challenge this request

upstream_sources.fact: Provider preference: deno 1000, node 900, quickjs 850, bun 800. Bun is capped at 1.3.14 and deprecated. quickjs-ng below 0.12.0 is missing optimizations.

upstream_sources.fact: Deno is the recommended runtime and is enabled by default; bun support is deprecated and versions after 1.3.14 are unsupported; quickjs-ng below 0.12.0 can take minutes per challenge.
